# Trusted records/JSON build fixture

This synthetic public fixture exports a WASIp2 HTTP handler and uses JSON plus
pre-generated `devoption:app/records@0.1.0` host imports. It is compiled only by the
explicit trusted Cargo proof; the test never invokes its handler or a database.

`src/bindings.rs` was generated by upstream `wit-bindgen-rust` 0.46.0 with default
`Opts` for `record-imports` in the repository's
`crates/devoption-runtime/wit/records.wit`, then formatted with rustfmt. It uses the runtime-only wit-bindgen
dependency; the application does not invoke the code-generation macro. Upstream
project: <https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wit-bindgen>, Apache-2.0 WITH
LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

The lockfile pins the requested JSON dependency closure. No dependency archives
or vendor directory are embedded here: the test requires operator-verified
prepared inputs and their independent tree digest. See
[the policy and test command](../../../../../docs/cargo-vendor-bundles.md#operator-audited-public-app-profile).
